> x : Int
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

fango's (/) only works on Float, but this operand is:

    Int

1| x / 2
   ^

Note: there is no automatic Int-to-Float conversion — use a
Float value here, like `2.0` instead of `2`.
> -- UNHANDLED EFFECT ------------------------------------- <repl>

This top-level value performs an effect that is not handled.
Top-level bindings must be pure; move the call into a function or add a handler.

1| x = print 1
       ^^^^^^^

Note: a closed effect row cannot absorb additional effects
> -2 : number
> | | | "b" : String
